sentences.text: HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners after arguing the matter at length seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the petition and avail of such remedy as is available in law.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner further seeks liberty to approach this Court in the event of filing of the charge sheet.
3. Liberty so sought is granted.
The petition stands disposed as withdrawn.
